missions.title: Deliver the first zero-gravity garden
missions.summary: Bring six hardy basil seedlings to the Sprout station. Tiny roots, giant leap.
missions.nextStep: Finish the humidity sensor calibration before docking.

missions.title: Unmute the lunar lighthouse
missions.summary: Beacon's relay keeps broadcasting elevator music instead of landing coordinates.
missions.nextStep: Wait for ORB-106's receiver patch, then replay the relay handshake.

missions.title: Map the marshmallow meteor shower
missions.summary: Chart a safe corridor through a surprisingly fluffy asteroid belt.
missions.nextStep: Find a flight cartographer and verify the star-map reference frame.

missions.title: Return the lost rover's mixtape
missions.summary: Recover Rover's favorite playlist from an abandoned observatory. Yes, it is all space jazz.
missions.nextStep: Archived: playlist checksums match and Rover is doing a little dance.

missions.title: Teach a satellite to say hello
missions.summary: Give our newest weather satellite a friendly, accessible first-contact message.
missions.nextStep: Review the plain-text fallback with the flight crew.

missions.title: Patch the deep-space receiver
missions.summary: Replace a noisy decoder so Beacon can hear mission control again.
missions.nextStep: Bench-test decoder v2 against the captured Beacon packet fixture.

missions.title: Inspect the orbital snack cupboard
missions.summary: Audit the emergency biscuit inventory and reseal the floating crumbs.
missions.nextStep: Get a fresh inventory count; the last update is nine sols old.

missions.title: Hang a welcome sign on Mars
missions.summary: A small sign for a planet. A big welcome for the next curious visitor.
missions.nextStep: Archived: sign installed, alt text recorded, postcard sent.
